hook: Your idea of a tree breaks on Socotra, Yemen.
title: Trees That Look Like Umbrellas and Bleed Red
description:
Socotra is an island in the Arabian Sea that belongs to Yemen. Its dragon blood trees grow in an umbrella shape and ooze a deep red sap. It really looks like another planet.

#Shorts #Geography #Socotra
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
